Ruth, the brief is set up but not running yet. The job is saved to post in #strategic-random at 07:45 Central (12:45 UTC) each morning, covering #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford. It won't fire until the Hermes gateway is started on this host, which isn't running now.

I also posted three messages in this channel, and the first two were wrong. I said the first brief would be due 15 Oct, which I couldn't confirm. The scheduler's next run shows 27 Oct because it uses its own clock, not the simulation clock. The third message corrected this, but the thread now has three messages from me where one would have done.

To go live, someone needs to start the gateway, and then the first run should be checked against the schedule.
